record.title: Independently verify mode-zero ADC contract recovery
record.intent: Check authored formulas control flow tables and classifications against stock bytes before choosing dynamic validation.
requirements: Independently inspect stock byte ranges branch coverage call bindings field mappings table bounds and all hardware-facing operations in the selected mode-zero closure.

Reproduce extraction or checking outputs and test meaningful altered-contract rejection for operands bounds signedness or omitted branches where machine checking is supported; do not treat matching generated assertions as independent proof.

Report unresolved algorithms runtime inputs and genuine hardware behavior separately; reconcile material errors before accepting the graph and preserve an explicit limit if complete recovery is not supported.
No guest execution or new model responses; preserve stock hashes and commit and push the reviewed static conclusion.
acceptance: An independently reviewed bounded static contract or precise unresolved limit is committed and pushed.
